sourceScopeNotes: Current corporate careers page declares the native Brillio board. Its reviewed anonymous filter_jobs client posts unfiltered search values to the public WordPress AJAX search, replacing obsolete guessed path pagination and card/detail delimiters. All advertised pages and a second complete inventory precede any cap. Native numeric posting ID and title-owned requisition remain distinct. Full visible role criteria and exact native privacy-notice application identity are required for detail completeness. LTR is retained without inventing employment or work arrangement; document template dates are kept separately from unknown role dates. City-only country, uncertain visibility, hidden criteria, unresolved JobPosting schema, request failure, native denial, changing inventory or caps keep partial results and disable cleanup. The captured 219-posting inventory includes two city-only country records, so employer-wide India coverage remains partial.
